functions.name: tab.open
functions.description: Opens a web page in a new tab of your own (http or https; localhost:5173 means http://localhost:5173) and waits up to 30 seconds for it to load. Your tabs have their own cookies, separate from the person's and other agents'. Returns the tab with id, url, title, error if loading failed, status (HTTP status of the page) and errors (number of errors on the page; details with page.errors).

functions.name: tab.navigate
functions.description: Loads another address in one of your tabs and waits up to 30 seconds. Returns the tab, with error, status and errors as tab.open.

functions.name: tab.list
functions.description: Lists your own tabs with id, url, title, loading, error, status and errors.

functions.name: page.text
functions.description: Returns the visible text of the page in one of your tabs (at most 100000 characters).

functions.name: page.click
functions.description: Clicks the first element matching a CSS selector in one of your tabs.

functions.name: page.fill
functions.description: Sets the value of the first input, textarea or select matching a CSS selector in one of your tabs, as if typed.

functions.name: page.errors
functions.description: Returns the errors and warnings of the page in one of your tabs, oldest first (at most 200): the page itself failing to load or answering with HTTP 400 or higher, console errors and warnings (uncaught exceptions included), and other requests that failed. Pass since (milliseconds since the epoch, the time of an entry) to get only newer entries. The list starts over when the tab loads another page.

functions.name: page.screenshot
functions.description: Saves a PNG screenshot of one of your tabs and returns its file path.
